why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open beta.loafmarkets.com/league and press Join Competition.

Sign up. The docs say you can "register with email or connect a Web3 wallet". Warning This is a testnet. The app warns: "Do NOT send any real funds to your address as you won't be able to recover them".
Link X if you want to use referrals. It's optional.
Wait in the queue. The app shows your estimated round and says it will notify you when you have a seat.
When you have a seat, trade during the round with the mock funds you're given. Place at least one trade, or you won't get a rank.

If you finish in the paid places, use Claim Prize. "Winning players have 30 days from the conclusion of a round to nominate a valid payout destination". After that the prize is lost, so Round 3 winners have until about 5 December.
costs: It's free. The terms call the beta "A FREE, EXPERIMENTAL, SIMULATED TESTING ENVIRONMENT". You get test funds for nothing, and they "cannot be purchased, sold, withdrawn, redeemed, transferred for value, or converted". Trades carry fees of 0.05% maker and 0.1% taker, paid in mock money. Mainnet fees aren't published. Future property sales would be for wholesale investors only, at "1000 property uni
risks: No country list is published. The terms bar sanctioned people and "a jurisdiction we have designated as restricted", without naming them, and the docs say "Participation may be unavailable or restricted in certain jurisdictions or regions". We found no statement on US users either way. "you must be at least 18 years old", and VPNs used to hide your location are banned. Most players earn nothing. O
